I have enough to answer.

h14.

**Computation site:** `internal/markdown/markdown.go`, method `(*service).ExtractAll` (around lines 356-414), invoked via `RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-87`. `ExtractAll` does a single goldmark AST walk over the memo's raw markdown content and populates a `MemoPayload` (`Tags` and a `Property` sub-message, `MemoPayload_Property` defined in `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:85-95`). `RebuildMemoPayload` writes the result into `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`, which is persisted alongside the memo row (`store/memo.go`) and used to render memo lists/previews without re-parsing content each time.

**Triggers (recomputation):**
- On memo creation — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`, inside `CreateMemo`, called on the newly built memo before it's persisted.
- On memo update, but only when the update mask includes the `content` field — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`, inside the `path == "content"` branch of `UpdateMemo`. Updating other fields (visibility, pinned, etc.) does not trigger recomputation.
- Bulk/backfill path — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` (`Runner.RunOnce`) rebuilds the payload for *every* memo in batches of 100 and writes it back via `Store.UpdateMemo`. Note: this runner is defined but, unlike the `s3presign` runner, is not wired into `server.startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go` — no code path currently invokes `NewRunner(...).RunOnce`/`Run`, so it appears to exist for manual/migration use only (not an active recurring trigger today).

**Extracted properties** (from the single AST walk in `ExtractAll`):
- `Tags` — all `#tag` nodes found in content (deduplicated, case preserved).
- `Property.Title` — text of the first-level (H1) heading, only if it's the first block-level node in the document.
- `Property.HasLink` — set if any Markdown link node is present.
- `Property.HasCode` — set if any code block, fenced code block, or code span is present.
- `Property.HasTaskList` — set if any task checkbox is present.
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — set if any task checkbox is unchecked.
- (Also collects `Mentions` in the same pass, though that's returned in `ExtractedData` rather than stored in `Property`.)

<result>I now have all the information needed. Let me report the findings.

## Findings: Memo derived/computed metadata (usememos/memos repo)

### 1. Where derived metadata is computed

**Primary extraction logic** — `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go`

The `markdown.Service` interface parses a memo's raw content (goldmark AST) and derives metadata. Key methods:

- `ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)` (lines 356-422) — single-pass extraction of tags, mentions, and properties (most efficient, used in production paths):
```go
type ExtractedData struct {
    Tags     []string
    Mentions []string
    Property *storepb.MemoPayload_Property
}
```
  - Extracts `#tags` via `TagNode` AST nodes (line 376-378)
  - Extracts `@mentions` via `MentionNode` (line 379-381)
  - Extracts `Title` from the first H1 heading if it's the first block in the document (lines 384-389, using `extractHeadingText`, lines 172-179)
  - Sets `HasLink` when any `KindLink` node is found (line 393-394)
  - Sets `HasCode` for code blocks/spans (line 396-397)
  - Sets `HasTaskList` / `HasIncompleteTasks` for task checkboxes (line 399-405)

- `ExtractTags` (lines 142-170) and `ExtractProperties` (lines 192-241) — standalone versions of the same extraction (used in tests/other call sites), also compute `Title`, `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks`.

- `GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)` (lines 263-346) — walks the AST to build a plain-text preview/snippet, skipping code blocks, respecting word boundaries, truncating with `... ` suffix (via `truncateAtWord`, lines 470-489). This is the "preview/excerpt" generator.

**Rebuild orchestration** — `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`

```go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
    if memo.Payload == nil {
        memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
    }
    // Use goldmark service to extract all metadata in a single pass (more efficient)
    data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
    if err != nil {
        return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to extract markdown metadata")
    }
    memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
    memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
    return nil
}
```
This is the exact function that "derives" the memo's metadata and writes it into `memo.Payload` (tags + property struct).

### 2. What triggers recomputation

- **On create**: `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` — `CreateMemo` calls `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService)` before `s.Store.CreateMemo`.
- **On update, only when content changes**: `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:435-451` — inside `UpdateMemo`'s field-mask loop, only `if path == "content"` triggers a rebuild:
```go
if path == "content" {
    ...
    memo.Content = request.Memo.Content
    if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
        return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
    }
    update.Content = &memo.Content
    update.Payload = memo.Payload
}
```
  Updating visibility, pinned, state, timestamps, etc. does NOT recompute the payload — it's purely content-driven.
- **Batch/backfill runner**: `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72` — `Runner.RunOnce` pages through all memos (`ListMemos`, batch size 100) and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for each. Note: this runner is **not currently wired into `startBackgroundRunners`** in `/bench/home/work/server/server.go` (only `s3presign.NewRunner` is started there) — it appears to be a maintenance/migration utility not currently invoked automatically at server startup, unlike the s3presign runner.
- **Ad hoc snippet generation** (not stored, computed on demand): `s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet(...)` is called directly (not persisted to `Payload`) at:
  - `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-89` (`getMemoContentSnippet`) — used to build outbound webhook payload snippets.
  - `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:318-325` (`memoNotificationSnippet`) — used for comment/mention notification snippets (`MemoSnippet`, `RelatedMemoSnippet`).
  - Mentions are also re-extracted (not persisted separately) whenever `resolveMentionTargets` runs, via `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32` (`s.MarkdownService.ExtractAll`), used for mention notification dispatch.

### 3. Specific derived properties (stored in `MemoPayload`)

Schema — `/bench/home/work/proto/store/memo.proto:7-29`:
```protobuf
message MemoPayload {
  Property property = 1;
  Location location = 2;
  repeated string tags = 3;

  message Property {
    bool has_link = 1;
    bool has_task_list = 2;
    bool has_code = 3;
    bool has_incomplete_tasks = 4;
    // The title extracted from the first H1 heading, if present.
    string title = 5;
  }

  message Location {
    string placeholder = 1;
    double latitude = 2;
    double longitude = 3;
  }
}
```
